text:
harper: opened PR adding a short migration appendix for Private v1->v2 (networking key renames, kube-proxy notes, HSM cert rotation steps). PR: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/2501. Would appreciate infra + docs quick look.

ivan: Nice. Please include a small mapping table for config keys (externalAddr -> public_host, listenPort -> ingress_port). Customers trip over this.

jo: I'll add that and a tiny sed one-liner for bulk edits: `sed -E 's/externalAddr/public_host/g; s/listenPort/ingress_port/g' conf.yml > conf.v2.yml`. Also adding a short bullet about masquerade vs. SNAT on kube-proxy for sealed sites.

docs-bot: Linkcheck: 1 broken anchor in PR #2501 -> /install/private#network-checks. Suggested replacement: /install/private/networking-checklist. Label: doc:link-fix.

harper: pushed update with the key table and sed example. Also added an SDK snippet for a minimal private-endpoint retry using `requests` and `verify` pointing to private CA:

```python
import requests
from time import sleep
for attempt in range(3):
    r = requests.post('https://10.1.2.3:8443/api/generate', json=payload, verify='/etc/ssl/redwood-ca.pem')
    if r.ok:
        break
    sleep(2 ** attempt)
```

ivan: LGTM. One infra note: some HSM appliances renumber PKCS#11 slots after firmware updates; add a troubleshooting line to re-check slot indexing and token labels after rotation.

jo: added that and a short Windows cert import example for docs: `certutil -addstore -f "ROOT" C:\certs\redwood-ca.pem`. Marked Windows paths as escaped for copy/paste.

docs-bot: CI: docs lint OK, spellcheck flagged 'masquerade' (accepted).

harper: thanks — I'll merge on green and add a changelog entry. Follow-up: expand appendix into full migration guide in next sprint. :thumbsup:
